description_en: Clears the accumulated messages of a consumer group when using AMQP server-side subscription
description_zh: 使用AMQP服务端订阅时，调用该接口清空某个消费组的堆积消息
name: ResetConsumerGroupPosition

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no Overview page or ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The consumer group ID. After you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170388.html to create a consumer group, the consumer group ID is returned. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170419.html to query the consumer group ID by consumer group name
parameters.help_zh: 消费组ID。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170388.html创建消费组成功后，会返回消费组ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170419.html按消费组名称查询消费组ID
parameters.name: group_id
